Contact: +91 90621 50656 Gaya Pind Daan Reality: Shocking Room Tour at Bharat Sevashram Sangha! (Unfiltered)
Namaste everyone! Join me on a revealing journey to Gaya, Bihar, a sacred destination for Hindus performing Pind Daan. In this video, I share my personal experience staying at the Bharat Sevashram Sangha, a popular accommodation choice for pilgrims. While Gaya holds immense spiritual significance, my room stay was...unforgettable, to say the least.
